# Test fixtures

Every fixture here is **invented**. None is a capture or a scrubbed copy of a
real record, document, study or provider response.

- `stream/synthetic.ndjson` is a `records-stream/v1` stream as a provider CLI
  writes it: 14 FHIR R4 resources for a synthetic patient, Robin Testperson,
  born 2020-02-02, at "Example Health" (`https://fhir.example.org/r4`). It
  carries two DocumentReference and Binary pairs, one of them an EOB that an
  ExplanationOfBenefit points at through `supportingInfo`, and its trailer.
  The Binary PDFs are generated by `medrec::pdfgen`.
- `stream/fakeprov-info.json` is the `info --json` of `fakeprov`, the fake
  `health-records/v1` provider that `medrec::testdata::write_provider` writes.

The scans, DICOM studies and the fake provider script are generated at test
time by `medrec::testdata` (and by `cargo run --example synth -- <DIR>` for
dogfooding).

The rules:
- People are `Testperson`, with birth dates 1990-01-01 and 2020-02-02.
- Organizations are `Example …`, at `example.org` and `example.com` hosts.
- Identifiers are obvious dummies (`pat-0001`, `MEMBER-0000000001`).
- DICOM UIDs sit under `2.25.0`.

Clinical codes (LOINC, ICD-10, RxNorm, CVX, CPT) are real public codes,
because they carry no personal data. `tests/fixture_shapes.rs` and
`tests/no_personal_data.rs` enforce these rules.

Never add a real record, study, header or screenshot here, scrubbed or not.
